A mature Twilight Chord resembles a rolling constellation: seven translucent, fist-sized spheres arranged in a hexagonal cluster, each connected to the others by six living filaments of rubbery, bioluminescent gel. A fourth detects seismic vibrations through the crystalline sand, feeling the footsteps of distant creatures. Because the spheres are linked by the conductive filaments, they share sensations instantly—a touch felt by one is known by all, creating a gestalt awareness that makes the Chord unnervingly coordinated.
